theme_and_archetype.description: A 'Godly' high-end dark mode fintech dashboard. Uses a near-black canvas (#0A0A0A) to reduce eye strain, high-contrast white typography for primary metrics, and vivid semantic colors (green/red) exclusively for financial movements. The aesthetic is 'Swiss Noir'—sharp 0px borders, dense data presentation, and extreme precision.

colors.philosophy: Dark-First Canvas. Color is used strictly for function, not decoration. White is the primary action color. Green and Red are strictly reserved for financial changes (profit/loss).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: The 'Control Room' Grid. Dense, data-rich, yet readable. Every pixel utilized with intention.
spacing_and_layout.page_structure: Sidebar or Top-Nav layout. Main content area must have generous padding (p-6 md:p-12).

grid_system.base: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Numbers and currencies MUST be right-aligned in tables. Labels and text left-aligned. Optical alignment over geometric.

components_strategy.cards: Flat surfaces (bg-card), sharp 0px corners, 1px solid border (border-border). NO heavy drop shadows, use inner shadows or borders to define edges.
components_strategy.headers: Crystal Glassmorphism if scrolling (bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border), or solid flat if fixed.
components_strategy.buttons: Primary CTAs are stark white (bg-primary text-primary-foreground). Secondary are muted outlines. No gradients on buttons. Hover states explicitly define background and text.
components_strategy.tables: Dense. Row borders only (border-b border-border/50), no column dividers. Hover state on rows: bg-secondary/50. Font-mono for all numeric data.
components_strategy.charts: Use Recharts wrapped in Shadcn Chart. Line charts should use vibrant neon accents (green/red) with gradient fill under the line (opacity 0.1 to 0) to ground the data.
components_strategy.forms_inputs: Shadcn inputs. bg-transparent, sharp corners, border-border. Focus state: ring-1 ring-primary border-primary.
components_strategy.data_testid_requirement: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, toggles, row actions) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid='add-expense-submit-button'`, `data-testid='expense-amount-input'`).

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Must be high-contrast. Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-[1px]) or borders glow/lighten. Text colors must remain visible.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Staggered fade-in and slide-up (translate-y-2 to 0) for dashboard widgets upon load.
motion_and_interaction.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Ensure focus rings are high contrast (white ring on black background).

icons_and_assets.usage: Use 'Duotone' or 'Regular' weight. Keep them sharp and minimal. Replace Lucide where possible for a more premium feel.

backgrounds.description: Monochrome geometric abstract background with polygonal shapes creating a 3D effect. Use with a heavy dark overlay (bg-background/90) as a subtle texture for empty states or onboarding.

placeholders.description: White wall paint with black shadow. Use as a minimalist placeholder texture for empty receipt image uploads.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL DEPENDENCIES: Run `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react recharts date-fns` before starting any development.

CSS INJECTION: Overwrite the entirety of `/app/frontend/src/index.css`. Insert the @import url for Google Fonts (Outfit, Manrope, JetBrains Mono) at the top. Replace the :root and .dark variables with the exact HSL strings defined in `css_variables` here. Make sure .dark is the default or enforce it on the html/body tag.

TAILWIND CONFIG: Update `/app/frontend/tailwind.config.js`. Extend the theme with `colors: { profit: 'hsl(142 71% 45%)', loss: 'hsl(348 83% 47%)', warning: 'hsl(38 92% 50%)', obsidian: '#0A0A0A', surface: '#121212' }`. Set the font families: `sans: ['Manrope', 'sans-serif']`, `heading: ['Outfit', 'sans-serif']`, `mono: ['JetBrains Mono', 'monospace']`.
LAYOUT & UI ARCHITECTURE: Implement a full-screen dashboard layout. Sidebar nav is preferred. Use the defined 'Control Room' grid system (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4).

TYPOGRAPHY EXECUTION: All financial figures, balances, and dates MUST use `font-mono`. Use the custom semantic colors `text-profit` for positive flows and `text-loss` or default foreground for expenses.

COMPONENT OVERRIDES: Customize all Shadcn primitives to use `rounded-none`. The aesthetic must be sharp, aggressive, and highly precise. Do not use generic soft shadows; rely on 1px solid borders (border-border).

BUSINESS LOGIC (RULE-BASED CATEGORIZATION): Build a simple dictionary/switch function mapping keywords (e.g., 'uber', 'lyft' -> 'Transport'; 'starbucks', 'mcdonalds' -> 'Food') and run it automatically onChange or onBlur of the expense description input.
BUDGET ALERTS WIDGET: Create a visual progress bar. Dynamically apply Tailwind classes based on percentage: < 80% use standard foreground/accent, > 80% use `bg-warning`, > 100% use `bg-destructive`.

TESTING IDs (CRITICAL): Ensure absolutely every input, select, button, chart container, and table row has a descriptive `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='expense-list-row-1'`). Do not skip this step.
DATA PERSISTENCE: Use LocalStorage to persist the single user's expenses, budgets, and categories since there is no backend authentication required.
